requirement_text: The mobile football app must be available for download and installation on both Android and iOS devices.
requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want the app to be available on both Android and iOS so that I can use it on my device, regardless of platform.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I have a device running Android or iOS,
When I search for the app in the Play Store or App Store,
Then I must be able to find and download the official football app.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to select their favorite teams and preferred sports channels to display a personalized news feed.
requirement_reference: "users can display current football news of their favorite teams and also select preferred sports channels individually."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to select my favorite teams and sports channels so that I receive news most relevant to my interests.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I am on the news customization screen,
When I select a team and sports channel,
Then the displayed news feed must show current news related to my selected preferences.

requirement_text: The app must provide a live ticker feature that displays real-time match results for users' favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want to follow live scores of my favorite teams so that I stay updated during matches.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I have selected favorite teams,
When a match is being played,
Then the app must show real-time scores in the live ticker.

requirement_text: The app must offer coverage and display information for all major football leagues and competitions, both national and international.
requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."

user_story.story: As a user, I want access to information on any league or competition so that I can follow all football events of interest.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I navigate to leagues or competitions,
When I select any available option,
Then I must see the corresponding information regardless of country or competition.

requirement_text: The system must provide detailed information and statistics about teams and players at all times.
requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to access detailed information about teams and players so that I can learn more about them whenever I want.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I search or select a team or player,
When the player or team page loads,
Then I must see up-to-date stats and biographical info.

requirement_text: The app must integrate live stream links from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport, displaying them to users when the live broadcast has begun and rights are available.
requirement_reference: "integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport...available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun...Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want to view live stream links for matches when they are available in my country so that I can watch live football easily.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given a live match with a broadcast right for my country,
When the broadcast begins,
Then the corresponding streaming link must be displayed in the app.

requirement_text: The app must ensure live stream links are displayed only when the transmission rights are fulfilled for the user's country.
requirement_reference: "Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to only see streams that I am legally allowed to view in my country so that I do not encounter unavailable content.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given my country matches the broadcast rights,
When I access live stream options,
Then only legal and available streams must be shown.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to enable notifications for current events regarding their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated.", "Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to receive notifications about my favorite team's results and news so that I stay informed instantly.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I have enabled notifications and selected favorite teams,
When a relevant event occurs,
Then I receive a push notification from the app.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to share news articles and game reports via social media directly from the app.
requirement_reference: "users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to share interesting news and reports on social media so that I can inform my friends and followers.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I am viewing a news article or game report,
When I tap the share option,
Then I can post the content to my chosen social platform.

requirement_text: The registration and login process must be straightforward and allow users to complete signup or login directly at app startup.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."

user_story.story: As a new user, I want a simple way to register or log in so that I can start using the app without hassle.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I launch the app for the first time,
When I choose to register or log in,
Then I can complete the process in a few straightforward steps.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to personalize the app by following preferred clubs and configuring the app interface to their preferences.
requirement_reference: "users can follow favorite clubs...additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to follow clubs and configure the app interface so that my experience matches my interests.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I go to personalization settings,
When I select clubs and adjust the interface,
Then the app reflects these changes.
